evidence_quotes.O: Just out of curiosity I took out a nikon 17-55mm F2.8 and a tokina 11-16mm F2.8 for a test comparison because of the hype about this tokina lens.
evidence_quotes.C: after reading all reviews from amazon and other internet sites I came to the conclusion that perhaps the f1.8 is a superior all around lens
evidence_quotes.E: Bokeh is super and this is just an AWESOME lens. Pricey but well worth it! This is fast, tack sharp and just one heck of a lens!
evidence_quotes.A: I recommend it to all camera users to protect their investment!
evidence_quotes.N: I have been having a hard time convincing myself to clean my sensor and I finally did it.
